sentences.text: The morphology of Pavo miejue closely matches the genus Pavo, a group that does not currently occur in Taiwan.
Pavo miejue was significantly larger than modern galliform birds found in Taiwan, with a size comparable to large peafowls.
The fossil material was discovered by private collector L.-R. Hou in the Chiting Formation of Tainan City, Taiwan.
Pavo miejue extends the known distribution of the genus Pavo to easternmost Asia.
The Paleobiology Database currently has no specific record for Pavo miejue, only for the genus Pavo.
